response.statement: [re SC-N1 — M6 reading] Acknowledged and closed as recorded: the M6 route swell plays as COMMITMENT — the act chosen despite the cost — while the text alone carries the surveillance; watchedness receives its answer 8 s later in the calibration variant's unresolved semitone. I do NOT want watchedness at M6 itself, now or in a later cycle: the two voices doing different jobs at the same moment (score carries the choice, words carry the cost) is the design. No score-packet territory is opened at M6. Matches my chapter-note-01 §2. [re SC-N2 — M2 whisper] Acknowledged and closed: M2's weight is carried by the text BY DESIGN — 'everything after this is allowed to be heavy' is permission granted to the future, not description of the present; the accretion arc arriving over the next four stages IS the weight. The note stands as the authored-choice citation if a naive viewer flags score/line mismatch at M2. I would object to a bench swell if one were ever proposed. [re SC-N3 — major objection] OBJECTION ACCEPTED IN FULL — all four contract terms, consistent with my chapter-note-01 §1: (1) the contract's cue relations freeze SHIPPED behavior only (score-treatment.md §3 shipped column: held generic-ramp 0.5 across the window); (2) the near-silence intent at anchor.ch8.contact-logged and the composed emptiness at anchor.ch8.open-query are recorded as UNMET-BY-SHIPPED, carried by the separately-routed packet 'ch8-launch atmosphere-exit window score authority' with the bounded scope of score-treatment.md §5 plus my constraints (a) decay keys on the durable deep_space fact never the copy clock, (b) nothing stamps CONTACT LOGGED., (c) L6's emptiness is never filled; (3) the dissent-register entry stands verbatim until the packet lands or the owner declines it; (4) no contract, evidence, or review text may describe the shipped window as near-silent — I will enforce this wording in the contract I author and in my own intent language. One factual update folded in: the window's internal offsets are revised (CONTACT LOGGED. at +8.5, designation +11.5, L6 +14.0; advance unchanged at +17.0) — per your own SC-N5 the intensity seam is event-anchored to the advance and the plateau is identical across the window, so the objection's measurements and all four terms transfer unchanged to the revised offsets. Closure is yours to confirm, not mine. [re SC-N4 — exit cadence, D9] Accepted with one interval adjustment that your note pre-authorizes: the frozen ch7 exit mini-cadence is +0.0 M7 audit / +0.6 M7 caption / +3.0 exit caption / +5.0 advance — the exit slot moves from Cinematography's proposed +2.6 to +3.0 because the M7 caption is 63 chars and needs ~2.1 s of typewriter reveal. Your ruling stated zero score cost at every offset with the calibration mood holding through the window and the seam unaffected by where inside the hold the captions fire, so your D9 signature transfers to the +3.0 table without re-ruling. D9 at 5.0 s now has all three lanes aligned and freezes with this cadence. [re SC-N5 — L6 tail] Accepted and decided on legibility grounds as you suggested: L6 moves to +14.0 with the advance HELD at +17.0 (inside R2's recorded bound), and the room is made upstream by compressing the stack (+2.0/+4.0/+6.0, CONTACT LOGGED. +8.5, designation +11.5) rather than by extending the beat. Your event-anchored seam finding (setScoreMood at the advance event, not wall-clock) is what makes the compression safe score-side and is cited in the contract term. The packet-preference observation (longer tail = more genuine emptiness for the open query) is noted for the packet's audition cycle.

response.statement: [re CN-N1 — ch7 exit mini-cadence, critical] Accepted in structure — the cadence table freezes as a contract term alongside D9=5.0 s, in named constants, exactly as your Ruling A signature requires; your same-tick collision catch (M7 edge and the shipped exit latch testing the same receipt in the same tickReconstruction pass) was correct and the intent's missing offsets were my gap. ONE VALUE ADJUSTED: exit caption at +3.0, not +2.6. Character math in your own tuning style: the M7 caption is 63 chars × 34 ms ≈ 2.1 s reveal; your +0.6 → +2.6 slot gives it 2.0 s — a mid-typewriter overwrite of M7, the exact defect class this run exists to kill. At +3.0 the M7 slot is 2.4 s (2.1 reveal + 0.3 read) and the exit caption still gets 2.0 s held in-beat (1.3 s reveal + 0.7 s read) plus ~0.2 s into the accepted-drift board overwrite. Frozen table: M7 audit +0.0 / M7 caption +0.6 / exit caption +3.0 / advance +5.0. Score has pre-cleared any offset inside the hold (SC-N4). Please confirm the +3.0 slot satisfies your signature condition. [re CN-N2 — L6 tail] Accepted via your option 1 (L6 +14.0, advance +17.0 — inside R2's recorded bound) with the designation-slot problem it would otherwise create solved upstream: moving L6 alone to +14.0 cuts the designation caption's slot to 1.5 s, under its ~1.8 s reveal (54 chars × 34 ms) — a mid-typewriter overwrite of the run's most canon-sensitive line. So the stack compresses: L4 +0.0 / stack 1 +2.0 / stack 2 +4.0 / stack 3 +6.0 / CONTACT LOGGED. +8.5 / designation +11.5 / L6 +14.0 / advance +17.0. Slot math: audit reveals need only 0.5–1.2 s at 22 ms/char so the printer cadence loses nothing; CONTACT LOGGED.'s near-empty-band punch slot GROWS 2.5 → 3.0 s; designation keeps 2.5 s; L6 gets your ≥3 s tail (1.4 reveal + 1.6 held). Variant D still publishes at ~1.75 s, before stack 1. Score confirms the intensity seam is event-anchored to the advance and survives unchanged (SC-N5). Please confirm and update your capture-spec item 4 offsets to match when the contract freezes. [re CN-N3 — liftoff routing] Routing decided: option (i) — the separately-routed bounded camera packet on cin.launch.02-world-below, your recommendation. L3 FREEZES AS WRITTEN in this contract; I will not reword — the refusal seen from the air is story truth and rewording to match a nose-up sky frame surrenders the payoff to shot convenience; retiming to ignition kills 'the site gets small' as you noted. Dissent-register entry (text in chapter-note-02 §3, for your co-signature): L3's image support is OPEN — the tree is not findable in any captured liftoff frame; the line ships as authored interior truth pending the packet; if the owner declines the packet, L3 returns to me as a routed repair with contractChangeRequired: true, never a silent reword. Chapter-side constraints attached to the packet scope: (a) attitude authoring over any forced glance — no look seizure; if only a control-taking glance can deliver the tree, that returns to the triad; (b) no marker, glint, or HUD affordance on the tree — the finding stays voluntary and unrewarded; (c) movie autopilot inherits the attitude so the movie path stops contradicting the line; (d) hand-back unchanged at anc.launch.atmosphere-exit so the L4–L6 window is untouched. Score confirms zero coupling with your packet (SC-N7), so it routes independently of theirs. [re CN-N4 — audit-pill persistence] Accepted as an intended-accept contract note, verbatim intent: the M7 AUDIT NETWORK pill persisting ~1.5 s into ch7-board's black boarding-occlusion frame is authored behavior — the band is built to survive cutscene treatment, and the index following the worker into the cockpit is tonally correct; reviewers and the cohesion judge should find it pre-recorded, not rediscover it as a state-clear defect. One boundary restated so the record cannot drift: this intended-accept covers the audit band's TTL persistence ONLY — it does not soften the separate accepted-drift record (R1/D5) for the caption band's parenthetical overwrite at the same seam. [re CN-N5 — integration constraints] Both integration constraints accepted as contract implementation terms, and I will author them into the contract: (1) every cadence offset in both tables ships as a named constant — the contract freezes relationships AND values, per the intent's own cadence doctrine; (2) the M7/exit same-tick hazard is solved BY the cadence offsets, never by reordering latch checks inside tickReconstruction — and the same prohibition applies to tickLaunch's hold offsets. Agreed on the rationale: latch-order surgery would trade a visible collision for a fragile implicit ordering dependency on the shared predicate that any future tick edit could silently regress; the cadence makes the ordering explicit, tested, and owner-tunable. The lock's permitted once-only latch tests will cover both tables.
